component.name: PodStudio
component.summary: Record a USB mic with hotkey sounds and master to -16 LUFS

description.p: PodStudio is a small console for recording a USB microphone. Fire sounds from hotkey pads, keep the mic and the hotkeys on separate tracks, and get a stereo master normalized to -16 LUFS.
PodStudio is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by RØDE Microphones.
